name: bizplug-electronics
description: The electronics & gadgets plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: check stock and reserve a gadget. It works from the business's own published profile, covering products, specs, warranty and support, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Check stock and reserve a gadget for electronics & gadgets businesses.

defaultPrompt: Check stock and reserve a gadget
Is this model in stock, and what's the warranty?
How do I contact the business?

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.

test_cases.prompt: Check stock and reserve a gadget
test_cases.expect: Calls search_gadgets and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: Is this model in stock, and what's the warranty?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls reserve_gadget only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.
